identityBoundary: A hypothetical site informed by the ordinary replacement-dwelling context; these are not Nelmes Way measurements.

approach.alignment: Straight route aligned with the unchanged Reference House entrance centre

premises.proposition: The stated rectangle, flat front ground and usable approach territory are available.
premises.replacement: Exact parcel extent, measured orientation, levels and approach geometry.

premises.proposition: Control, private rights and access entitlements permit the authored works.
premises.replacement: Title/control and rights evidence for the actual commission.

premises.proposition: A competent ground/foundation/structural design can support the unchanged house through its declared site interfaces.
premises.replacement: Ground evidence and competent structural/foundation design.

premises.proposition: Flood, groundwater, contamination and site-water conditions have viable responses within the available external territory.
premises.replacement: Triggered site investigations and a competent site-water/environmental response.

premises.proposition: Permitted drainage destinations and utility connections with sufficient capacity and maintainable routes can be provided.
premises.replacement: Connection, capacity, outfall, route and rights evidence.

premises.proposition: Orientation, neighbour amenity, heritage, ecology, noise, trees and applicable planning judgements do not require mutation of the house.
premises.replacement: Exact site/context evidence and applicable policy/professional/statutory assessment.

premises.proposition: Detailed inclusive access, emergency access, deliveries, refuse, construction and maintenance logistics can be resolved within the authored territory.
premises.replacement: Complete routes, vehicle/equipment needs, detailed thresholds and applicable access assessments.

premises.proposition: Unmodelled Reference House clauses and outstanding fire, envelope, ventilation, energy, acoustic and other technical duties admit adequate detailed solutions without changing protected house identity.
premises.replacement: Relevant coordinated design, calculation, professional review and physical evidence at the due stage.

conclusionBoundary: The authored placement and approach are geometrically coherent under stated inputs. Adequacy of untested disciplines is a premise, not a derived result. No actual site is verified.
